implemented_now: Website capability snapshot/transaction gate without a public route
exact immutable financial reference DTOs/append-only primitives
stock custody exclusion and immutable successor relation
all-table retention classification and FK barriers

monetary-adjustment.v1.amount: positive canonical decimal(19,2) string; no float/rounding
monetary-adjustment.v1.replay: same UUID, parent and complete snapshot only; each non-manual source effect UUID is globally one-use; no totals applied by the reference store

project-milestone.v1.identity: UUID plus approved quote public UUID; unique positive sequence; quote FK in persistence
project-milestone.v1.limits: sum of approved allocations <= quote approved amount under current quote lock
project-milestone.v1.history: paid/expired quote allows identical reference replay only, never a new allocation or amount change

locking: Owning business transaction and fresh authorization precede internal primitives. Retry the whole business transaction on bounded deadlocks, not only an effect fragment.
Capability creation locks profile/revision until commit; publication must lock the same singleton. Missing/unpublished profile denies new creation.
Stock/custody writers lock source/destination products in ascending ID order, then units/claims/holds; existing own reservation never excludes a custody hold.

Financial references lock invoice/order or quote parent then current reference rows. Quote allocation reads are locking reads. Cross-aggregate orchestration must choose a consistent order before MT-2.7 processing.
identity_invariants: Products/units retain origin IDs and codes. Successor occurrences are new and link forward without branching/cycles.
In-transit serialized claims remain attached to held origin until an atomic receipt moves the claim; global IMEI uniqueness is never temporarily disabled.
Supplier/PO/receipt/trade-in line UUIDs require the owning workflow to resolve an actual authorized row before attaching an acquisition reference.
Order milestone relationship must match quote, exact amount/currency and quantity one; FK existence alone is not payment authorization.
No public history grant is inferred from an operating mode or contact details. Explicit account membership or scoped approved-payment capability is mandatory.

performance.measurement: representative stable production-build/device/network evidence at consuming points; foundation build is not performance acceptance
